S9_문제해결접근.meta_note_screening_protocol: Four S9 candidates tested this session against the same isolated control. Three (S9-N3 PCA, S9-N4 upwind_projection, S9-N5 veer/jet) showed real screening-positive results that fully reversed under fold-outside. The fourth (S9-N6 REWS) showed the WEAKEST screening signal of the four and was the one that HELD (even grew) under fold-outside. This argues against 'ignore all screening-only signals' as a blanket rule and toward 'screening magnitude is not predictive of fold-outside survival on this dataset' -- the only way to know is to run fold-outside every time. Recommendation stands: fold-outside is the primary measurement, screening is at most a cheap sanity check, but do not use screening magnitude to triage which candidates are worth fold-outside testing.

S13_사다리재진입_S5S6.lane_theory: 딥리서치 레인의 이론 성과: 채점행만 학습(+0.006161)은 트릭이 아니라 절단회귀 최적성이다. NMAE ∝ E_x[P(y>=c|x)·E(|yhat-y| | x,y>=c)]이고 P는 yhat과 무관하므로 최적 예측은 절단분포의 중앙값. 함의: (a) 손실은 L1/pinball-0.5여야 함, (b) 잔여 이득은 P(scored|x)∈(0.2,0.8) 경계영역에만 존재, (c) 행가중은 w=a+b·y로 지표가 문자 그대로 지정 — 저장소의 생산비례는 b극단, 균등은 a극단.

S6은 필요조건이지 충분조건이 아니다.
S13_사다리재진입_S5S6.LAW_teacher_realism: **교사 타깃의 현실성은 하류 정확도와 역상관이다.** 두 번 독립 확인: S13-N3(등장회귀로 pc_true→cf 단조사상, -0.022~-0.027)과 S13-N9(터빈별 NTF + 스톰제어 커브로 교사 MAE를 -5.7% 개선, 하류 -0.0003~-0.0014). 기전: pc_true의 가치는 불편향이 아니라 **무잡음**(측정풍속의 결정론적 함수)이다. 교사를 계측 진실에 가깝게 만들려면 반드시 가용률·정지·디레이팅 과정을 교사에 흡수시켜야 하는데, 그것은 예보시점에 예측 불가능한 잡음을 원래 깨끗했던 피처에 주입하는 것이다. 단조 편향은 하류 모델이 스스로 뒤집을 수 있지만 잡음은 못 뒤집는다. => 교사는 물리적·무잡음으로 유지하고 편향 보정은 하류에 맡길 것. '교사 타깃 개선' 계열 전체 폐쇄.
S13_사다리재진입_S5S6.S7_lane_verdict: 레인의 결정적 답: S7 단독으로 +0.0148은 불가능. 환산규약 상대 MAE -x% ↔ Δ(1-NMAE)=0.0013858x이고 목표는 -10.71%. A급 head-to-head 실측: Schulz&Lerch 2022 MWR (QRF→DRN -3.3%), Veldkamp 2021 MWR (QRF→CNN -4.1% MAE, RMSE는 -14.8%로 공간 CNN 이득의 2/3가 꼬리), Bruninx 2026 용량정규화 NMAE (NGBoost→Treeffuser -5.9%), GNN 2025 (CNN↔GNN 동률). 전부 필요치의 절반 미만이고 우리보다 약한 베이스라인 대비다. Bruninx가 같은 논문에서 추정기 5% vs NWP 소스 17%를 나란히 재는데 후자는 이미 닫혔다. 유도 2건: 발행이 하나뿐이라 리드타임≡시각+11로 완전공선(리드타임 축 사망); DRN/CNN 승리의 원천인 지점 풀링(175/46지점)이 3그룹에서 소거.

Then fit a small per-fold LightGBM L2 regressor on REWS features -> (actual_kwh - D_prediction) residual, fold-outside (trained on the other 2 folds only), added the prediction back to D, clipped to [0, 1.05*cap].
residual_correction_attempt.verdict: CLEAR NEGATIVE, with an identified methodological cause (not just 'REWS doesn't help'). D's prediction is the settlement-optimal ACTION under a step reward, not a conditional mean (this project's own standing finding, restated repeatedly in AGENTS.md/registry.json). Fitting a plain L2 regressor to (actual - D_prediction) treats that gap as an ordinary noisy regression residual, which is the wrong objective for a step-reward decision problem -- the -0.0548 solo collapse is consistent with the correction model fitting noise in a target that isn't actually well-behaved under L2 loss. This closes the residual-correction approach as attempted (do not retry with plain L2), but does not resolve whether REWS carries real information D's construction is missing -- a decision-theoretically consistent correction (e.g. correcting the underlying quantile/distribution D's decision layer uses, not correcting the final action directly) would be the honest next attempt, not undertaken this session.

regime_policy_attempt.method: The decision-theoretically consistent follow-up to the failed residual-correction attempt: instead of regressing a noisy row-level target, split rows into REGIMES by rews_ratio_L (per-group tercile cut points, fixed a priori from the other 2 folds only) and select a SEPARATE fold-outside (T,G) policy per (group, regime) cell -- the same kind of object (a policy) D's own decision layer already optimizes, with 0 extra fitted parameters beyond the a-priori regime boundaries. Note n_regimes=1 is NOT identical to D's own solo score -- D picks ONE policy for all 3 groups pooled, while even n_regimes=1 here picks a SEPARATE policy per group (3x the policy freedom), so n_regimes=1's own delta from D isolates the group-split effect, and n_regimes>1's further delta from n_regimes=1 isolates the REWS-regime effect specifically.
regime_policy_attempt.bug_found_and_fixed: The FIRST run of this script had a serious bug: it called lib.official_total() on group-filtered subsets directly, but official_total always computes a 3-group average internally -- feeding it a single-group subset leaves the other 2 groups empty, which silently produces NaN inside the per-group mean (numpy 'Mean of empty slice' / 'invalid value in scalar divide' warnings were the tell) and corrupts the resulting 'total'. The first run's n_regimes=1 'sanity check' returned 0.618830 instead of D's true solo score (~0.6257), which is what exposed the bug -- an initially-reported result of DEPAVG+D_REGIME3=0.635013 (delta -0.001171) was WRONG and has been superseded below. Fix: added group_partial_objective(), which reproduces official_total's per-group inner loop directly (nm_g, fi_g for one group only) instead of misusing the 3-group-averaging function on 1-group data.
regime_policy_attempt.verdict: STILL NEGATIVE (current_best not beaten) but the closest of every attempt this session (-0.000532, vs -0.001171 [now-retracted buggy number], -0.003592 from-scratch member, -0.004059 L2 residual correction). Both the group-split-only step and the added REWS-regime step are individually slightly negative in isolation (-0.000761, -0.000351) -- i.e. neither pure group-specific policy tuning nor REWS-regime conditioning shows a real gain here once measured correctly; the closer-to-current_best number comes mainly from the DEPAVG blend absorbing the loss, not from REWS adding value. Read this as a NULL result for REWS-via-regime-policy, not as 'nearly there' -- the correct fix (group_partial_objective) made the number look better only because it stopped being wrong, not because REWS started working. This line of attack (regime-conditioning D's decision policy on REWS) is now reasonably exhausted; do not iterate further on n_regimes or soft blending without new evidence REWS explains real variance in D's error, which no attempt this session (L2 residual, regime split) has shown.

(2) research/nodes/s7_savemembers.py's member loop selects only the top-150 columns by teacher feature_importance before calibration -- also never reproduced before.
